Once the firmware is downloaded to the device, the device shall decrypt the hash using a public key to verify that the firmware originates
If the verification succeeds, the device shall proceed with the firmware upgrade.
If the verification fails, the device shall abort the update process.
In case of failure, the bootloader shall place the device into upgrade mode（？should be out of upgrade mode） and report an error.

During a session, press and hold the session button for more than 2 seconds and less than 5
seconds, then release, to stop the session.

Or the session will stop automatically if a timeout occurs.
The session count is based on battery capacity.

code should be reported via the serial log, if a serial cable is connected and logging enabled.
